title: fidelity-kit suite configuration
description: fidelity.json at the root of a fidelity-kit results directory. Renderer and output IDs must also be unique; that rule is checked by the CLI because JSON Schema cannot express it.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation and completion.

title.description: Suite title shown in the viewer.

logo.description: Suite-relative path to a browser icon and navbar logo.
logo.errorMessage: logo must be a suite-relative image path (AVIF, WebP, PNG, JPG, SVG, or ICO)

renderers.description: Renderers whose images live at <scene>/<output>/<renderer id>.<extension>.
renderers.errorMessage: at least one renderer needs "reference": true

outputs.description: Output folders inside each scene. Defaults to a single "beauty" output.

id.errorMessage: ids must start with a lowercase letter or digit and contain only lowercase letters, digits, ".", "_", or "-"

label.description: Display name; defaults to the id.

reference.description: Compare other renderers against this one.

enabled.description: false hides the renderer by default; viewers can still turn it on.

id.description: Output folder name inside each scene.

label.description: Display name; defaults to the id.
